item.title: Health subsidies expire, launching millions of Americans into 2026 with steep insurance hikes
item.description: Enhanced tax credits that have helped reduce the cost of health insurance for the vast majority of Affordable Care Act enrollees expired overnight, cementing higher health costs for millions of Americans at the start of the new year. item.title: Slimantics: A bold new plan for keeping New Year’s resolutions
item.description: We are now one day into the new year, often referred to as 2026, and I suspect those among you who make New Year’s resolutions are feeling pretty smug and confident at this point. Not to rain on anybody’s parade, but 90% of those who make New Year’s resolutions don’t achieve their goals. Most resolutionaries are setting themselves up for failure.
